title: Chapter 264: Establishing A Teleportation Array
content:
Chapter 264: Establishing A Teleportation Array

The system announcement arrived as expected.

[System Announcement: Wana Village was the first to be upgraded to a town. I hope all lords will continue to work hard! ]

The three system announcements naturally caused a lot of waves among the village leaders.

"This Wang Shuo is awesome. How did he do it?"

"I guess it must have something to do with his attack on Nanshanji."

"It's confirmed. A friend of mine said that you have to attack the system town to upgrade the town."

"Oh my god, how can you get people to upgrade? Attacking a town, you really think of it!"

With Wang Shuo taking the lead, many lords became more active.

Especially those lords who are ranked high and have strength.

Maybe they can't take down a town alone, but they can also unite!

Wang Shuo didn't know that the Nanshan Association he founded opened an era of lords' union.

After upgrading the village, Wang Shuo built a teleportation array near the gate next to the teleportation gate of the ancient battlefield.

Now, Wana Town has two city walls.

The new building is the outer wall, and Wang Shuo plans to build the teleportation array between the inner and outer walls.

This will not only facilitate the teleportation of people from other places, but also block them outside the inner wall. This is also to prevent the teleportation array from being breached and the enemy directly teleporting into Wana Town.

[Are you sure you want to build a teleportation array here? ]

"Yes."

The teleportation array is a special building, which is automatically built by the system.

Wang Shuo now guessed that the so-called special building is just the construction technology that players are not yet able to master!

If one day, someone learns the teleportation array production technology, then players can prepare materials by themselves and build it by themselves.

Not long after, a huge altar stood in front of Wang Shuo.

Two-story high platform, white marble floor, four small steps on both sides, and low pillars.

The entire altar has no gaps at all, as if it was made by nature.

Wang Shuo walked up.

The system prompt sounded.

[The teleportation array of Wana Town has been established. You can now request to open the following teleportation arrays: Nanshanji (Village), Xiaochi Town, Qinghe Town, Scarborough Market, and Changping County. ]

Wang Shuo noticed at this time that after taking the heart of Nanshanji Town, Wang Shuo did not take out the village building order, so Nanshanji still existed as a third-level village.

At the same time, no one destroyed the teleportation array, so it could continue to operate.

Wang Shuo was a little unsure about the attitude of other towns, so he did not rashly request to open the teleportation array.

He only opened the teleportation array with Nanshanji.

The actual controller of Nanshanji is still Wang Shuo, so it is very simple to open the teleportation array.

Set the teleportation fee to 1 gold coin.

Wang Shuo stood on it, paid 1 gold coin, and was teleported to the teleportation array of Nanshanji.

"Haha..."

It's quite fun.

In this way, it becomes extremely convenient to reinforce Nanshanji from Wana Village.

Wang Shuo's mind became active. When the undead army attacked, maybe he could still save Nanshanji.

This thought only flashed through his mind. Where would there be so many people to defend it!

Thinking of this, it seemed that there were still a large number of prisoners who had not been dealt with.

Wang Shuo immediately asked people to bring all the prisoners to the central square.

There were more than 10,000 people in total, and the whole square was full of people.

Many people squeezed into the flowers on the edge.

Wang Shuo stood on the high platform, his eyes swept across the faces of the people one by one, and there were many familiar faces among them.

Including Zhuge Kewei, Yue Ji, Fan Chengyang and others.
